target.title: fix: restrict non-owner gateway tool inventory [AI]
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with non-owner Gateway access could have owner-only Gateway control tools included in chat-driven agent runs.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared agent tool-policy pipeline now treats an explicit non-owner sender identity as a hard deny for the owner-only Gateway core tools. This uses the existing owner-only tool classification and applies it before the final model tool inventory is returned, including inherited tool surfaces for spawned sessions and scheduled follow-up jobs.

## User Impact

Non-owner Gateway chat turns no longer receive privileged Gateway, scheduler, or node-control tools. Owner/admin Gateway runs and local runs without an explicit non-owner identity keep their existing tool surface.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-tools-agent-config.test.ts` passed: 24 tests.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/agent-tools.create-openclaw-coding-tools.test.ts` passed: 68 tests.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- Remote Testbox proof was attempted but blocked because the local Crabbox binary is 0.20.0 and the repo wrapper requires >=0.22.0 for Blacksmith Testbox; direct AWS Crabbox was also blocked by missing broker login.

AI-assisted: yes.
